text: Enno Raschke Thank you both! We went in person and sent several emails to the Argentine Embassy but they essentially refused to provide us with a letter or any documentation. They claimed they aren't able to and provided no further assistance. I have a fingerprint form for background checks that states on there it can be done at any Consulate but when I emailed this to them they just referred me to the Embassy website and didn't help again. I just wrote them another urgent email.
